stroke_encoding: Each stroke is an ordered polyline; points are [x,y]. Stroke array order is part of the label signal.

ambiguity_risks: push if arrowhead is interpreted as motion
can resemble frost or physical if diagonals shorten
near target if the square is lost
target-ray shares arrow semantics

cooldown.intent: four cardinal ticks around an empty center
ambiguity_risks: sparse marks can collapse under crop

self.intent: outer diamond enclosing a small diamond
ambiguity_risks: target is the open reticle
can resemble cooldown if the square is lost

physical.intent: crossed blades with a short guard
ambiguity_risks: damage also uses crossing diagonals

fire.intent: angular flame silhouette with inner tongue
ambiguity_risks: frost if corners are over-smoothed
damage burst is similar at a glance

arcane.intent: five-point star with vertical rune stroke
ambiguity_risks: damage burst if the rune is dropped
attacker if the slash is read as a body

on-hurt.intent: open C receiving a blow from the left
ambiguity_risks: shield if the opening is closed

on-use.intent: held square with a downward tap
ambiguity_risks: area if the tap is read as a center

periodic.intent: clock circle with a single hand
ambiguity_risks: area is a circle with a center dab and no hand
shield if the cleft is lost
on-hurt if the eyes disappear

if-outdoors.intent: small sun with four short rays
ambiguity_risks: cooldown has no center disc
self is nested diamonds, not a kite

attacker.intent: inverted-V figure crossed by a slash
ambiguity_risks: on-hit is a downward V without a torso

area.intent: containment ring around a center dab
ambiguity_risks: periodic has a clock hand instead of a dab
push/target-ray are single arrows
cooldown ticks sit at the canvas edge
must not resemble a positive glyph

global_ambiguity_risks: target-ray and push remain the closest arrow pair; keep shaft length distinct.
periodic is a clock with a hand; area is a ring with a center dab.
on-hit is a downward strike; attacker adds a torso slash.
if-outdoors has a center disc; cooldown does not.
